image_description: A crowded aquarium scene featuring multiple marine fish. The primary subject in the foreground right is a large angelfish with a yellow-gold posterior and dark anterior, resembling a Rock Beauty or similar Holacanthus species. To its left is a large blue angelfish (likely a Queen Angelfish). In the background, there are various other fish including silver/grey species and smaller yellow/blue fish swimming near wooden structures and rocks.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Striking gold and black coloration: anterior body and head black, posterior body and tail golden yellow with black margin.

The head/face area appears olive-green/yellow rather than solid black, and the transition is gradual rather than the sharp black-to-gold split typical of the species. It resembles a juvenile or a different Holacanthus species (e.g., Ciliaris) more than the adult Rock Beauty.

checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The dorsal fin is continuous along the back. While individual spines/rays are hard to distinguish due to image quality, the structural continuity is present.
The anal fin is visible and mirrors the dorsal fin's structure.
The caudal fin (tail) is visibly rounded, not forked or lunate.

Several small fish in the background appear to merge into the rock/wood texture or have indistinct, melting fins, indicating poor structural definition common in AI-generated crowds.
The wooden beam behind the fish has inconsistent perspective lines and seems to warp slightly around the fish bodies, suggesting weak spatial grounding.
